summary: The mail sender setup now reports ready only when Exchange has really confirmed it.

fixes.title: Mail sender setup reports ready only when true
fixes.text: The mail sender setup uses the mailbox's real primary address, reuses a scope that already covers it, and reports ready only once Exchange confirms each sending identity.
fixes.action: If the mail sender setup ends as pending, re-run it later.

fixes.title: Clear stop when converting from Linux
fixes.text: Converting to private from a Linux shell such as Azure Cloud Shell now refuses the Rebuild route at the start instead of failing halfway.
